description: Asks, on a writable copy, how Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) evaluates UPDATE assignments over Dm, in sequence, each followed by RecordsAffected, DBEngine.Errors and the rows (ID, V, N, S) of Dm: a later assignment reading a column assigned earlier in the same SET, the reverse order, a swap of two columns, a qualified and an aliased target, a never-true WHERE, a concatenation over a Null, a row-value SET, a FROM clause, a scalar subquery, a domain function and an aggregate over the table being updated, a conversion of text into a Long column in both directions, a Long into a text column, and a primary-key shift (ID = ID + 1, then ID = ID - 1 for ID > 1). Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
